# Documentation Index

Generated and hand-written documentation for `edge_ai_compiler_pro`.

## 🟢 新手从这里开始

- [`TUTORIAL.md`](TUTORIAL.md) — **零基础入门教程**（中文）：从"编译器是什么"讲起，
  用生活化比喻解释 IR / 方言 / Pass / 融合 / 量化 / 内存规划 / lowering / 运行时等全部概念，
  并带一章可亲手运行的命令演练。**没学过编译原理也能读懂。**

## Auto-generated (from ODS / TableGen)

- [`EdgeDialect.md`](EdgeDialect.md) — the `edge` dialect overview (generated by `mlir-tblgen -gen-dialect-doc`).
- [`EdgeOps.md`](EdgeOps.md) — every `edge` operation: syntax, operands, attributes, traits, interfaces
  (generated by `mlir-tblgen -gen-op-doc`).

Regenerate with:

```bash
mlir-tblgen -gen-op-doc      -I include/Edge -I <mlir-install>/include -I include -I build/include \
  include/Edge/EdgeOps.td -o docs/EdgeOps.md
mlir-tblgen -gen-dialect-doc -dialect=edge -I include/Edge -I <mlir-install>/include -I include -I build/include \
  include/Edge/EdgeOps.td -o docs/EdgeDialect.md
```

(The build also wires these via `add_mlir_doc` in `include/Edge/CMakeLists.txt`.)
